gen-almendra-display-gf-lexend-exa: Almendra Display has an ornate, bookish look, its letters never pinching shut. Lexend Exa follows in wide sans forms of uniform line thickness, with stubby ascenders that keep the text block sturdy and low.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-sintony: Expressive and loud, Autour One has no hairlines to vanish. Sintony takes over with a chunky, tall midzone and smooth curves that never clog, so a long passage would glide along without snagging.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-savate: Savate reads smoothly, with sturdy hairlines and open jaws on its curves. Funnel Display does the commanding work, its spaghetti-like strokes holding one weight, while Savate softens that with gentle modulation in the text.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Commanding but approachable, this pairing starts with Goldman's wide, generous stance. Schibsted Grotesk brings big open e and a shapes with tall bowls, and its terminals never close in, which is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-sen: Grandstander's plain constant-width lines hold letters open instead of curling them shut. Sen carries on in a plain sans of tall lowercase and curves that stop before turning inward, so extended reading feels brisk and clear.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-sofia-sans: Gugi has tall lowercase nearly reaching its capitals, with terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. And Sofia Sans, a plain sans with no thick-and-thin modulation, echoes that height in rounded, open-sided letters.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-sofia-sa: Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders barely clearing the x-height, with terminal tips pointing outward in a level, accent-free rhythm. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed would read steadily over a long stretch, each curve entered through a visible opening.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-syriac-eastern: Eater looks dark and aggressive, with hairline-free thin strokes, wide gaps between letters, and short ascenders over moderately weighty stems. Noto Sans Syriac Eastern is the real strength, approachable in tall lowercase.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-syriac-western: Whimsical, stubby, towering lowercase. Flavors keeps diagonals as heavy as stems, while Noto Sans Syriac Western is the real strength here, its small letters thick with height and terminals held far from the stroke.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Audiowide looks like bent copper pipe, tubular and futuristic. Noto Sans Bengali brings the pair's strongest quality, distinctly open letter mouths under capitals barely taller than its lowercase.
